name: Visit Essex — Win tickets to BBC Gardeners' World Autumn Fair
notes: Official Visit Essex (visitessex.com) competition, no purchase necessary. Prize: 2x VIP tickets for the winner + a guest to BBC Gardeners' World Autumn Fair, Sun 13 Sept 2026 at Audley End House and Gardens. Closes Mon 31 Aug 2026, 5pm BST. Entry form includes a required free-text 'Title' field (Mr/Mrs/Ms/...) that Profile has no equivalent for — the adapter fills everything else and fails loudly at that step. Add a title field to Profile to unblock this one.
